name: WHOOP MCP Server
description: Enables LLMs to retrieve and analyze sleep, recovery, and physiological cycle data from the WHOOP API. It provides tools for accessing detailed metrics such as strain, HRV, and readiness scores through secure OAuth 2.0 authentication.
